# eci_kubernetes_cluster (Resource)

Managed Kubernetes Cluster

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eci_pricing" "vm_pricing" {
  name         = "M-8"
  pricing_type = "ondemand"
}

data "eci_pricing" "storage_pricing" {
  name         = "Block Storage"
  pricing_type = "ondemand"
}

data "eci_pricing" "ip_pricing" {
  name         = "Public IP"
  pricing_type = "ondemand"
}

data "eci_pricing" "lb_pricing" {
  name         = "Load Balancer"
  pricing_type = "ondemand"
}

resource "eci_kubernetes_cluster" "my_cluster" {
  name               = "my-cluster"
  target_version     = "v1.36.0"
  attached_subnet_id = "9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-8c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d"
  target_replicas    = 3

  control_plane_spec = {
    image_id         = "2c4e6a8b-0d1f-4e3a-9b5c-7d9e1f3a5b7c"
    storage_size_gib = 50
    pricing_ids = {
      vm_allocation = data.eci_pricing.vm_pricing.id
      block_storage = data.eci_pricing.storage_pricing.id
      public_ip     = data.eci_pricing.ip_pricing.id
      load_balancer = data.eci_pricing.lb_pricing.id
    }
  }

  username = "elice"
  password = var.node_password

  tags = {
    "created-by" : "terraform"
  }
}

variable "node_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attached_subnet_id` (String) id of subnet that the cluster nodes attach to
- `control_plane_spec` (Attributes) spec of the control plane nodes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--control_plane_spec))
- `name` (String) name of the kubernetes cluster
- `password` (String, Sensitive) login password of the control plane nodes. It cannot be changed after creation.
- `tags` (Map of String) User-defined metadata of key-value pairs
- `target_replicas` (Number) number of control plane nodes (1 or 3)
- `target_version` (String) kubernetes version of the control plane (e.g. v1.36.0). Upgrades are not supported yet, so it cannot be changed after creation.
- `username` (String) login username of the control plane nodes

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) the time when the kubernetes cluster is created
- `current_replicas` (Number) number of control plane nodes currently running
- `current_version` (String) kubernetes version that the control plane currently runs
- `deleted` (String) the time when the kubernetes cluster is deleted
- `endpoint` (String) kubernetes API server endpoint, set once the cluster is ready
- `id` (String) unique identifier of the kubernetes cluster
- `modified` (String) the last time when the kubernetes cluster is modified
- `organization_id` (String) id of organization that the kubernetes cluster belongs to
- `ready` (String) the time when the kubernetes cluster became ready
- `status` (String) status of the kubernetes cluster
- `zone_id` (String) id of zone that the kubernetes cluster belongs to

<a id="nestedatt--control_plane_spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `control_plane_spec`

Required:

- `image_id` (String) id of kubernetes node image of the target version
- `pricing_ids` (Attributes) pricing plans of resources created for the nodes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--control_plane_spec--pricing_ids))
- `storage_size_gib` (Number) size of each node's block storage in GiB

<a id="nestedatt--control_plane_spec--pricing_ids"></a>
### Nested Schema for `control_plane_spec.pricing_ids`

Required:

- `block_storage` (String) id of pricing plan for the node block storages
- `load_balancer` (String) id of pricing plan for the load balancer in front of the API server
- `public_ip` (String) id of pricing plan for the node public ips
- `vm_allocation` (String) id of pricing plan for the node VM allocations
